caption: This super easy, creamy pesto sauce can be enjoyed by the whole family, including your baby!  Here’s a list of what You need: * 1 cup of fresh basil (feel free to add more! 🫡) * 1 cup of baby spinach * 1 avocado * 3 tablespoons of cheese (I used grated parmesan)  * ½ cup of pine nuts (or other nuts like walnuts) * 6-8 tablespoons of Olive oil * 1-2 tablespoons of Lemon juice Blend until you get a creamy texture, and you’re done! Serve it as a pesto spread over bread or mix with pasta for fresh pesto pasta! 🌿  For Zenith, I added a few drops of @biogaiausa  Probiotic drops for my baby’s Colic & Digestive Comfort. After setting aside what you plan to serve to your baby, add some salt, garlic, and more cheese to enhance flavor for yourself & other adult members of the family! I had fresh pesto pasta as lunch, and it was so good. You can consume all the pesto sauce with above ingredients for one meal between two adults & a baby, but if you have any leftovers, store them in freezer for a month!  #BioGaiaUSA #BioGaiaBaby #biogaiaaldermis #PestoSauce#FreshPesto#BabyMeals#ToddlerMeals#BLW#BabyLedWeaning#cooking#cookwithme#Homemadesauce#BLWrecipes#BabyFood#toddlereats#mukbang#healthyrecipes#nycmom#momvlogger
